description: Header file defining the ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL class, which traverses shader storage buffer variables to generate HLSL code for reading, writing, and managing shader storage blocks in ANGLE's shader translation pipeline.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
classes.description: A class that traverses shader storage buffer variables to generate HLSL code for buffer operations.

methods.name: ShaderStorageBlockOutputHLSL
methods.description: Constructor initializing the traverser with output, symbol table, resources, and shader storage blocks.

methods.name: outputStoreFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Writes part of the function call to store a value to an SSBO.

methods.name: outputLoadFunctionCall
methods.description: Writes the function call to load a value from an SSBO.

methods.name: outputLengthFunctionCall
methods.description: Writes the function call to get the length of an unsized array member of SSBO.

methods.name: outputAtomicMemoryFunctionCallPrefix
methods.description: Writes atomic memory function calls for SSBO.

methods.name: writeShaderStorageBlocksHeader
methods.description: Outputs the header for shader storage blocks.
